feasibilityScopeHint: Select a scenario to edit its assumptions. Residual values are indicative, not valuations or planning permission. Review proposed inputs; incomplete scenarios cannot be compared reliably.
feasibilityZoning: Approved in the building model: GRZ {grz} · GFZ {gfz}.
feasibilityReportHint: PDF of the saved study with all inputs and their sources
feasibilityReportSaveFirst: Save the study to download its report
feasibilityConflict: Someone saved a newer revision. Your edits are preserved and cannot overwrite it. Copy anything you need before discarding your edits and reloading.
feasibilityFixInputs: Correct invalid inputs before saving or using these results.
feasibilityUnsavedHint: Leave this study and discard your unsaved changes, or stay to save them?
feasibilityErrorNumber: Enter a non-negative number, e.g. 1,000 or 0.75 (maximum 1 trillion).
feasibilityErrorRatio: Enter a ratio greater than 0 and at most 1, e.g. 0.75, not 75.
feasibilityHintAcquisition: Percent of land price: transfer tax, notary, registry and broker.
feasibilityHintRatio: Living area ÷ gross floor area; e.g. 0.75 means 75%.
feasibilityHintFinancing: Lump-sum percent of construction, renovation and other costs; not an annual interest rate or land financing.
feasibilityHintContingency: Percent of new construction costs only.
feasibilityHintRevenueRate: Percent of sale revenue or capitalised rental value.
feasibilityHintOperating: Percent deducted from annual gross rent.
feasibilityHintCapitalization: Annual net rent ÷ rate; must be greater than zero.
feasibilityHintFloorArea: GFZ-derived floor area is a starting assumption, not confirmation that it can be built.
siteAssessmentScope: Arithmetic capacity assessment, not a permit decision or building placement. Enter a source-linked, reviewed footprint from the planning envelope; this tool does not derive geometry. Additional storey areas assume separately supplied and reviewed geometry; setbacks and stepped-floor geometry are not calculated.
siteAssessmentarithmetic_envelope_only: Only the arithmetic envelope is assessed.
siteAssessmentnot_permit_or_placement: No permit decision or geometric placement.
siteAssessmentsection34_comparison_only: Section 34 requires a qualified surroundings comparison.
siteAssessmentunreviewed_evidence: Some evidence has not been reviewed.
siteAssessmentextra_area_exceeds_gfz: Additional countable area exceeds GFZ capacity.
siteAssessmentInvalid: Check numbers and source dates before saving.
siteAssessmentExplanation: The footprint envelope is the smaller of GRZ × parcel area and the reviewed envelope: {footprint}. Full-storey capacity is footprint × full storeys, limited by remaining GFZ capacity. Binding: {limits}. Countable GF is {gf}; unused GFZ capacity: {unused}.
berlinContextHint: Uses the saved project address. Results are proposals; select and review the parcel before saving its area.
berlinContextParcelsUnavailable: Parcel service unavailable. No absence finding.
berlinContextPreviewHint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Select a parcel on the map or in the table.
berlinContextNoParcels: No parcels returned in the searched 100 m square.
berlinContextPlansUnavailable: Plan lookup incomplete. Review official sources.
berlinContextPlanHint: The search includes nearby plans. Verify coverage and all amendments. Missing results do not establish § 34; no plan is adopted automatically.
siteAssessmentPanelHint: Changes stay in your draft until you save the assessment.
siteAssessmentVisualHint: Capacity comparison, not a building placement or permit. Select a limit to review its evidence.
siteAssessmentVisualEmpty: Add the site constraints to compare the available capacity.
siteAssessmentVisualGfz: GFZ allowance after additional countable area
siteGeometryNeedParcel: Adopt an official parcel in Site to start the georeferenced drawing.
siteGeometryMapHint: North up. Draw vertices, then finish the outline. Select a shape to edit its vertices; arrow keys move focused vertices. Public context is evidence, not an approved design.
siteGeometrySelectHint: Select a shape or parcel edge to inspect and review its evidence.
siteGeometrymissing_setback: Parcel edge needs a setback decision, including zero
siteGeometrystaffel_outside_below: Upper storey extends beyond the storey below
siteGeometryfull_storey_countability_rev: Full storey must be checked for countable area
siteReferenceAddressHint: Select the intended location explicitly. A nearby address is not proof of the project parcel.
siteReferenceNoAddress: No address candidates found. Check the saved project address.
siteReferencePartial: Some public sources are unavailable. Missing data is not evidence of absence.
siteReferenceCandidateHint: Public building observations, not statutory limits. GRZ / GFZ are parcel comparisons; GFZ estimates count reported storeys. Missing values remain unknown.
siteReferenceComparisonHint: Descriptive range of selected observations. It does not establish permissible development. Each metric shows its sample size and review state.
siteReferenceReviewHint: Choose one measurement to review its source. Changes remain in the assessment draft.
siteGeometryUseArea: Use usable area as capacity input
siteGeometrymandatory_line_unmet: A facade does not cover a mandatory building line
siteGeometrygeometry_operation_failed: Geometry operation could not be completed
siteEvidenceUploaded: PDF saved in project sources and selected. Proposals still require review.
siteEvidenceUploadedRefreshFailed: PDF uploaded, but the source list could not be refreshed. Refresh this view and select the saved PDF; do not upload it again.
siteEvidenceTypeFailed: Content could not be read reliably. Review the original document.
siteEvidenceTypeUnknown: No clear document type found in the content.
siteEvidenceTypeAmbiguous: Content suggests multiple document types; review the source.
siteEvidenceVisual: Interpret scanned page visually · one page
siteEvidenceHint: Choose a configured provider. Proposals remain unreviewed after adoption; verify the source and date before marking them reviewed.
berlinContextHeritageUnavailable: Some protection registers are unavailable; review the official records.
berlinContextHeritageHint: Nearby or address-point matches are review hints, not a parcel-wide protection determination. Empty results do not establish absence of restrictions.
siteAssessmentHeightNotSpecified: No height limit specified in reviewed source
siteDesignHint: Compares the actual proposed geometry with the reviewed planning limits. A reviewed result is not a permit.
siteDesignparcel_area_consistency: Entered vs. drawn parcel area, difference (m²)
siteDesignenvelope_area_consistency: Entered vs. drawn envelope area, difference (m²)
siteDesignscalar_parcel_disagrees_with_g: Entered parcel area differs from the actual polygon.
siteDesignscalar_envelope_disagrees_with: Entered footprint capacity differs from the geometric envelope.
siteDesigndesign_rules_unreviewed: Height and building-form rules need review.
siteDesignclosed_boundary_condition_unve: Closed building form needs verified boundary contact.
siteAssessmentSourcesAndRules: Site sources, references and planning rules
siteGeometryWebGLUnavailable: 3D rendering is unavailable in this browser.
berlinContextAdoptedNotice: {parcel} adopted: its area and boundary are in the draft, unreviewed. Review the parcel area in Planning limits, then save.
berlinContextHintAdopted: Look up again to compare parcels or check plan records. Adopting another parcel replaces the boundary and clears setbacks.
berlinContextNoHeritage: No heritage or preservation hints were returned. This does not establish that no restrictions apply.
berlinContextPickOnMap: Click the matching point on the map.
berlinContextNoPlans: No development plans were returned for this area.
siteAssessmentConfirmNeeds: Add {items} to confirm or mark as not applicable.
siteAssessmentNoOpenItems: No open items. The inputs are reviewed; this is still not a permit decision.
siteAssessmentOpenDesign: Resolve the checks in the editor and the design check
siteAssessmentOpenParcel: Look up and adopt the parcel
siteAssessmentPanelHintReadOnly: You can view the evidence; editing needs project write access.
siteAssessmentReportNotSaved: Save the assessment to export a report
siteAssessmentReportSaveFirst: Save your changes to include them in the report
siteAssessmentReviewNeeds: Add {items} to mark this as reviewed.
siteAssessmentSection34References: § 34 needs source-linked reference buildings with a reason for each. Selected: {count}.
siteAssessmentUnsavedReport: Unsaved changes · save to update the report
siteAssessmentUpsideHint: A separate, indicative scenario for additional storeys. It never changes the baseline and needs its own review and any authority decision.
siteGeometry3DNeedsContext: 3D needs nearby buildings: use Find nearby buildings in Site or load 3D location.
siteGeometryCandidatesNeed: Needs GRZ, GFZ and full storeys in Planning limits.
siteGeometryContextHint: Load nearby buildings in Site to see them on the plan and in 3D.
siteGeometryDrawHint: {tool}: click to add vertices ({count}) · double-click or Enter finishes · Backspace removes the last · Esc cancels
siteGeometryEdgeHint: Select a parcel edge to set its setback. Reviewed edges turn green.
siteGeometryReferenceHint: Select nearby buildings to add them as § 34 references.
siteGeometryHelpText: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom; in 3D, hold Ctrl or ⌥ while dragging to orbit. Click a parcel to pick it. Draw with E, L, X or B (plan or 3D); double-click, click the first corner or press Enter to finish, Esc cancels. ⌘Z undoes. T shows the site plan, 3 the 3D view, F fits the parcel.
siteGeometryNoBuildings: No building yet. Place one with B or generate variants.
siteGeometrySwitchToPlan: switch to the site plan (T) to draw
siteGeometryUseAreaHint: Proposes {area} m² as the planning envelope footprint. It starts unreviewed.
siteGeometryStatusHint: Public context is evidence, not an approved design
siteGeometryStatusHint3D: Drag to pan · Ctrl/⌥ + drag to orbit · scroll to zoom · illustrative massing
siteGeometryMassingPickParcel: Select a parcel on the map.
siteGeometryMassingDrawHint: Click the corners; double-click, click the first corner or press Enter to close. Setback areas follow live.
siteGeometryStaffelRuleHint: Suggested from {rule}: from {share} of the floor below (clear height ≥ 2.30 m) a Staffel counts as a full storey. Use 75 % only where an approval or Bauvorbescheid allows it.
siteGeometryMassingSetbackStaffelDepth: {depth} m from its own walls (0.4 H to its top)
siteGeometryStaffelProposalSource: Staffel proposal: footprint inset ≥ 1.5 m to at most {share} % of the floor below; check the Staffel rules of the approval or Bauvorbescheid
siteGeometryMassingSelectBuilding: Select a building to set its height.
siteGeometryMassingSetbackClear: Setback areas stay on the parcel without overlaps.
siteGeometryMassingSetbackOverlap: {area} m² overlapping other setback areas or buildings
siteGeometryMassingSetbackFailed: Setback areas could not be checked for this footprint.
siteGeometryMassingSetbackNote: Indicative live check (§ 6 BauO Bln); areas may reach the middle of a public road; neighbouring garages and sheds (Nebengebäude, § 6 (8)) are left out. Edge setbacks stay the calculation.
siteGeometryMassingDragHint: Drag the roof grip to extrude by floors, the building to move it.
feasibilityNoSiteAssessment: No saved site assessment yet: parcel area and buildable floor area can come from there.
siteAssessmentFinancialHint: Once saved, the Financial study can adopt the parcel area and this GF.
siteSummaryHint: From the saved project address: adopts the parcel, checks the plan register, proposes § 34 references and figures, building form from the neighbours, the setback hull and envelope, an exemption scenario and a massing. Everything is added unreviewed; reviewed or entered values are kept.
siteSummaryReviewNote: These are unreviewed proposals in your draft. Review each one, then save the assessment.
siteSummaryAfterParcel: Runs once the parcel is known.
siteSummaryParcelAmbiguous: Several parcels contain the address point. Choose the right one in Site.
siteSummaryParcelNone: No parcel contains the address point. Choose one in Site or check the address.
siteSummaryBasisBPlanFound: Plan {plan} is in force at the address.
siteBasisSuggestionNotChecked: The official plan registers have not been checked for this address yet.
siteBasisSuggestionUnavailable: The plan register was unavailable. Choose the basis yourself or check again later.
siteBasisSuggestionNote: Suggested from official registers; review before approval.
siteBasisSuggestionReadHint: Propose GRZ, GFZ, storeys and plan rules from {plan}, each citing its page.
siteBasisSuggestionFactsRead: Plan rules read from plan {plan} (cited page); review each value. No cited GRZ, GFZ or storeys were found.
siteSummaryBasisUnavailable: The plan register was unavailable. Choose the basis in Planning limits.
siteSummaryBasisInProgress: Plan {plan} is in progress. Decide the basis in Planning limits.
siteSummaryReferencesAdded: {count} nearest buildings with measured coverage. Give each a reason.
siteSummaryReferencesNone: No nearby buildings with measured coverage. Add references by hand.
siteSummaryFrameFilled: {items} from the maximum of the references (mean in the source).
siteSummaryFrameMissing: References lack these measurements. Enter them in Planning limits.
siteSummaryFramePlanMissing: Take GRZ, GFZ and storeys from the plan: interpret its PDF under Source documents.
siteSummaryFormClosed: Closed: neighbours stand on {count} boundaries; setback 0 there.
siteSummaryFormOpen: Open: {count} nearby buildings keep a boundary distance.
siteSummaryForm_built_to_one_boundary: A neighbour stands on one boundary only (semi-detached or end of terrace?). Decide the form.
siteSummaryForm_no_neighbours: No neighbouring buildings found. Decide the form.
siteSummaryEnvelopeProposed: Usable area {area} m² with 0.4 H, at least 3 m (H = {height} m).
siteSummaryEnvelopeNeedsHeight: Needs full storeys or a maximum height.
siteSummaryEnvelopeFailed: The parcel geometry could not be processed. Check it in Design.
siteSummaryUpsideProposed: {storeys} full storeys, only with municipal consent.
siteSummaryMassingNeedsFigures: Needs GRZ, GFZ, storeys and the envelope.
siteSummaryMassingPlaced: Placed with BGF {area} m²; drag it or change storeys in Design.
siteAssessmentRangeHint: The exemption adds {diff} BGF and needs municipal consent (§ 31 (3) or § 34 (3b) BauGB). Massing BGF is the drawn or generated building, not the arithmetic cap.
siteGeometryScenarioHint: Exemption preview: {storeys} full storeys, BGF {bgf} m². Generated and read-only; not part of the design check.
siteSummaryFramePlanExtracted: {items} read from plan {plan} (cited page); review each value.
siteSummaryFramePlanUnconfigured: Plan {plan} found. Connect the selected provider to read its figures, or enter GRZ, GFZ and storeys.
siteSummaryFramePlanEmpty: Plan {plan} was read, but no cited GRZ, GFZ or storeys were found. Enter them from the plan.
siteSummaryFormPlanClosed: Closed building form (geschlossene Bauweise) from the plan.
siteSummaryFormPlanOpen: Open building form (offene Bauweise) from the plan.
berlinContextPlanNoDocuments: No documents linked in the register
berlinContextLawHint_b_plan: The plan's figures decide; the site summary reads them from the plan sheet.
berlinContextLawHint_in_progress: Until adoption, § 34 or § 35 still applies; § 33 permission may be possible.
berlinContextLawHint_section34: No B-Plan in the register and building land in the land-use plan: the surrounding buildings set the frame.
berlinContextLawHint_section35: No B-Plan and open land in the land-use plan: building is generally restricted. Check with the authority.
berlinContextLawHint_unresolved: Plan register or land-use plan unavailable or inconclusive; check the official map.
berlinContextRatiosHint: From official building footprints. GRZ 1: main buildings. GRZ 2 adds garages, carports, sheds and underground garages; paved areas are not recorded, so it is a lower bound.
berlinContextStoreysMismatch: Listed {reported} storeys, the measured height suggests {n}. Listed data can be wrong.
berlinContextHeightStoreysSource: Storeys estimated from measured height {height} m at about 3.4 m per storey
berlinContextReferencesFrameHint: Mean – max. The maxima become the unreviewed limits used in Design.
siteSummaryBasisSection34Fnp: No plan covers the address; land-use plan: {landUse}. § 34.
siteSummaryBasisSection35: No plan and open land in the land-use plan ({landUse}): likely § 35. Clarify with the authority before assessing capacity.
siteAssessmentgrz2: GRZ 2 (incl. garages and ancillary, § 19 (4) BauNVO) · optional
siteAssessmentSection35Hint: In the outer area building is generally not permitted unless privileged or approved as an exception. The capacity below only shows what the figures would allow; clarify with the authority first.
siteAssessmentOpenSection35: Outer area: clarify permissibility with the authority
siteAssessmentsection35_outer_area: § 35 outer area: capacity is hypothetical until the authority confirms permissibility.
siteSummaryFrameSection35: Outer area: no figures are proposed. Clarify permissibility with the authority.
siteGeometryFootprintHint: Abstandsflächen {depth} m at {height} m wall height ({rule}) stay on the parcel and clear of neighbours. Unreviewed: drag or reshape it like any outline.
siteGeometryFootprintAbout: Largest footprint for the selected or a new building whose Abstandsflächen stay on the parcel, inside the Baugrenze and within GRZ and GFZ, at the full storeys from Planning limits.
siteGeometryFootprintNone: No footprint keeps its Abstandsflächen on this parcel at {storeys} full storeys. Check the parcel, the Baugrenze and the neighbours, or plan fewer storeys.
siteGeometryFootprintNoRule: The setback rule for this state is not captured yet; draw the footprint instead.
siteGeometryFootprintSource: Footprint proposal (footprint_proposal_v1): Abstandsflächen {depth} m at H {height} m ({rule}), limited by {binding}; unreviewed
siteGeometryFootprintBuiltTo: Neighbours stand on {count} boundaries, so it is built to them (closed building form, edges marked unreviewed).
buildingCodeSetbackCommercial: commercial and industrial areas {factor} H, at least {minimum} m
buildingCodePublicCentre: May lie on public traffic, green and water areas up to their centre
buildingCodePublicAllowed: May lie on public traffic, green and water areas
buildingCodePublicNo: Must lie on the parcel itself
buildingCodeAncillaryRule: Garages and buildings without habitable rooms up to {height} m mean wall height
buildingCodeStoreyFrom: Top storey counts as a full storey from {share} of the floor below with {height}
buildingCodeStoreyAbove: Top storey counts as a full storey above {share} of the floor below with {height}
buildingCodeHint: Applied in Design to the live Abstandsflächen check, the footprint proposal and the Staffelgeschoss share. Only verified rules are used; rule table {version}.
buildingCodeBoundaryDistance: at least {distance} m from the boundary
buildingCodeStoreyOwn: Full storey with {height} over {share} of its own area; no separate Staffelgeschoss rule
buildingCodeStoreyEvery: Every storey above terrain is a full storey; no area threshold
buildingCodeNotApplied: Not applied by the site tools
siteAssessmentRegimeCourtReview: Court review: {review}. Check which provisions still apply before relying on the figures.
siteAssessmentRegimeAtticCounts: Habitable rooms in attics and Staffel storeys count toward GF, even when they are not full storeys.
siteAssessmentRegimeAtticPlan: Attic and Staffel rooms count toward GF only if the plan says so.
siteAssessmentRegimeAncillary_overrun_50: Garages, parking and ancillary structures count toward the footprint; GRZ 2 may exceed GRZ by 50 %, at most 0.8.
siteAssessmentRegimeAncillary_not_counte: Ancillary structures do not count toward the footprint and there is no GRZ 2 cap; garages and covered parking up to 0.1 of the parcel do not count either (from 1968).
siteAssessmentRegimeAncillary_unclear: BO 58 does not settle how garages count; no GRZ 2 is proposed.
siteAssessmentRegimeOrdinanceUnknown: Version unknown: the site tools assume BauNVO 1990 (attic rooms count only if the plan says so; GRZ 2 up to GRZ + 50 %).
siteAssessmentRegimeBnpMapCaption: The ring marks the site. The colour gives the area type and building class.
siteGeometryBuildingLandHint: Parcel less street and other non-building land; GRZ and GFZ refer to this area (§ 19 (3) BauNVO).
siteGeometryUseBuildingLand: Use building land as parcel area
siteGeometryUseBuildingLandHint: Proposes {area} m², the parcel less street and other non-building land, as the parcel area for GRZ and GFZ (§ 19 (3) BauNVO). It starts unreviewed.
siteGeometryNonBuildingLandHint: Street, green or other land the plan takes out of building land. It also leaves the area GRZ and GFZ refer to.
berlinContextLawHint_baunutzungsplan: Former West Berlin without a newer B-Plan: the Baunutzungsplan with the Bauordnung 1958 applies. Read the building class from the plan map.
siteSummaryBasisBaunutzungsplan: No newer plan in {locality}: the Baunutzungsplan 1960 with BO 58 applies.
siteSummaryBasisBPlanCourtReview: Plan {plan} is in force, but a court found it {review}. Check which provisions still apply.
siteSummaryFrameBuildingClass: Read the building class from the Baunutzungsplan map under Planning limits.
siteAssessmentRegimeTransitional: Adopted within two years of a BauNVO change: if the public display began earlier, the older version applies. Check the plan's legend.
siteAssessmentReviewNameRules: Building form and height for the design
siteAssessmentReviewBindingCost: Without this limit alone: {area} more BGF
siteAssessmentReviewStreetCost: {land} of street or other non-building land on the parcel: {area} less BGF
siteAssessmentReviewCapacityOpen: Capacity follows once parcel area, GRZ, GFZ, footprint and storeys have values.
siteAssessmentReviewListLabel: Planning limits. J and K move, Enter accepts, E edits, R rejects.
siteAssessmentReviewRejectHint: Removes the value so it is entered again
siteAssessmentReviewNoEvidence: No plan sheet or site geometry yet.
siteAssessmentReviewCondition_core_conce: Does not touch the plan's core concept (Grundzüge der Planung)
siteAssessmentReviewCondition_justified: Justified by public interest, sound planning or hardship
siteAssessmentReviewCondition_neighbours: Compatible with public interests, including the neighbours'
siteAssessmentReviewCondition_municipal_: The district consents (§ 36a); deemed given after three months
siteAssessmentReviewCondition_consent_te: Consent may require terms, e.g. 30 % subsidised housing or infrastructure contributions
siteAssessmentReviewCondition_specialist: Noise, nature and monument law still apply
siteAssessmentReviewDeviationHint: Arithmetic on the capacity envelope: what each route would allow if granted. Exemptions are discretionary; this is not a permit forecast.
siteAssessmentReviewTaskReason_boundary_: Building on the boundary: neighbours' Baulasten (setback areas, attachment) can change what fits.
siteAssessmentReviewTaskReason_always: Not shown in the plan; binds any buyer.
siteAssessmentReviewTaskReason_rights_op: Easements (rights of way, utilities, building restrictions) are open in the checks.
siteAssessmentReviewTaskConflict: Project planning changed meanwhile. Try again.
